method: Static inspection of public bundle; not executed locally. Values below are source-defined, not runtime measurements.

facts.fact: Bundled GSAP banner identifies version 3.3.3; animation code uses its ticker/tween API.
Desktop non-iPad branch uses body wheel input to update a clamped target and a ticker to interpolate .a-scroll translate3d with coefficient 0.1. Device branch uses a native path.

Header Work/Bio transition clips the outgoing page horizontally over 1.5s expo.inOut; heading moves half a viewport width and mask moves one-third in the opposite direction. Supporting lines start after 0.5s, run 2s with 0.1s stagger and expo.out.
Contact transition collapses outgoing clip height over 1.5s expo.inOut. Contact heading rises from yPercent 100 after 0.75s, for 1.5s expo.out. Links enter after 0.8s for 2s with 0.1s stagger.
Project transition collapses outgoing clip height over 1.5s expo.inOut and moves menu links out; back branch restores saved work scroll offset.
Router registers default and contextual work, back, header, contact and campaign transitions; precise router package not established.
